sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's interface is simple and easy to navigate, with clear visual cues and intuitive controls that make it easy to get started. The game's mechanics are centered around the classic 'Red Light, Green Light' concept, where you need to move forward when the light is red and stop when it's green.

As you progress through the levels, the game introduces new obstacles and challenges that require you to adapt and react quickly. The game also features a unique 'Follow the leader' mechanic, where you need to mimic the movements of the leader and avoid getting caught out. This adds a new layer of complexity to the game and requires you to pay close attention to the leader's movements.

One of the standout features of 456 Squid Game Challenge is its ability to adjust the difficulty level to suit your playing style.
